## Notes

- The capture script renders each HTML file in headless Chromium at a
  1280x800 viewport, waits 700ms after the `load` event (so the on-load
  JS that auto-expands the Revoked section settles), then writes a PNG.
  Full-page captures use Playwright's built-in `full_page=True`; the
  scroll-captures mode steps through the document height in `--scroll-step`
  pixel increments and writes one viewport-sized frame per step.
- The visual checks (WV-06-01 .. WV-06-10) are validated by reading the
  PNGs and judging against the backlog's criteria; the harness only
  proves that the captures themselves were produced successfully. The
  read-the-PNG step happens in the same round and is logged above.
- No HTML/report regressions detected -- the four reports from W-05 render
  correctly with all required sections, colors, and data populated.

## Bugs fixed during harness development

None. The capture script and visual checks all worked on first run.
